mapper.select: WITH BaseTime AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN CURRENT_TIME AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' < '09:00:00' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'))::BIGINT ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CURRENT_DATE)::BIGINT END as start_time ), DailyStats AS ( SELECT token_id, SUM(trade_volume) as daily_vol, MAX(high_price) as daily_high, -- 오늘 최고가 MIN(low_price) as daily_low -- 오늘 최저가 FROM token_quotes, BaseTime WHERE candle_time >= start_time GROUP BY token_id ), OpenPrice AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, opening_price FROM token_quotes q, BaseTime bt WHERE q.candle_time >= bt.start_time ORDER BY token_id, candle_time ASC ), LatestPrice AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, closing_price FROM token_quotes ORDER BY token_id, candle_time DESC ) SELECT t.token_id, t.token_name, t.ticker_symbol, COALESCE(lp.closing_price, t.issue_price) as marketPrice, -- 현재가(종가) COALESCE(op.opening_price, lp.closing_price, t.issue_price) as openPrice, -- 시가 COALESCE(ds.daily_high, lp.closing_price, t.issue_price) as highPrice, -- 고가 COALESCE(ds.daily_low, lp.closing_price, t.issue_price) as lowPrice, -- 저가 COALESCE(ds.daily_vol, 0) as dailyTradeVolume FROM tokens t LEFT JOIN DailyStats ds ON t.token_id = ds.token_id LEFT JOIN OpenPrice op ON t.token_id = op.token_id LEFT JOIN LatestPrice lp ON t.token_id = lp.token_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS null ORDER BY dailyTradeVolume DESC

WITH minute_stats AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, closing_price AS market_price FROM token_quotes WHERE unit = 1 ORDER BY token_id, created_at DESC ), daily_stats AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, trade_volume AS daily_trade_volume FROM token_quotes WHERE unit = 1440 ORDER BY token_id, created_at DESC ) SELECT t.token_id AS token_id, t.token_name AS token_name, t.ticker_symbol AS ticker_symbol, COALESCE(ms.market_price, 0) AS market_price, COALESCE(ds.daily_trade_volume, 0) AS daily_trade_volume FROM tokens t LEFT JOIN minute_stats ms ON t.token_id = ms.token_id LEFT JOIN daily_stats ds ON t.token_id = ds.token_id
(t.token_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%') OR t.ticker_symbol ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%'))
ORDER BY ds.daily_trade_volume DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT order_id, order_side, order_price, order_volume, remaining_token, created_at FROM orders WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND token_id = #{tokenId} AND order_type = 'LIMIT'::order_type_enum AND remaining_token > 0 AND order_state IN ('NEW'::order_state_enum, 'PARTIAL'::order_state_enum) ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT closing_price FROM token_quotes WHERE token_id = #{tokenId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ts.asset_type = 'CASH'::asset_type_enum THEN ts.amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN ts.asset_type = 'TOKEN'::asset_type_enum THEN ts.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS price, MAX(CASE WHEN ts.asset_type = 'TOKEN'::asset_type_enum THEN ts.amount END) AS volume, ( SELECT o2.order_side FROM transaction_hists ts2 JOIN orders o2 ON ts2.order_id = o2.order_id WHERE ts2.trade_id = ts.trade_id ORDER BY o2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS takerSide, MAX(ts.created_at) AS createdAt FROM transaction_hists ts JOIN orders o ON ts.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.token_id = #{tokenId} AND ts.transaction_type = 'TRADE'::transaction_type_enum GROUP BY ts.trade_id ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT token_id, candle_time, opening_price, high_price , low_price, closing_price, trade_volume, unit FROM token_quotes WHERE token_id = #{tokenId} AND unit = #{unit} AND candle_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY candle_time LIMIT 1000

WITH BaseTime AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN (CURRENT_TIME AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') < '09:00:00'::time THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_DATE AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' - INTERVAL '15 hours'))::BIGINT ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_DATE AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' + INTERVAL '9 hours'))::BIGINT END as start_time ) -- 1. 가격 정보 (현재가, 시가) 계산 Prices AS ( SELECT t.token_id, COALESCE( (SELECT closing_price FROM token_quotes WHERE token_id = t.token_id ORDER BY candle_time DESC LIMIT 1), t.issue_price) as market_price, COALESCE( (SELECT opening_price FROM token_quotes WHERE token_id = t.token_id AND candle_time >= (SELECT start_time FROM BaseTime) ORDER BY candle_time ASC LIMIT 1), (SELECT closing_price FROM token_quotes WHERE token_id = t.token_id ORDER BY candle_time DESC LIMIT 1), t.issue_price) as open_price FROM tokens t WHERE t.token_id = #{tokenId}), -- 2. 당일 집계 정보 계산 DailyStats AS ( SELECT token_id, MAX(high_price) as daily_high, MIN(low_price) as daily_low, SUM(trade_amount) as daily_vol FROM token_quotes WHERE candle_time >= (SELECT start_time FROM BaseTime) AND token_id = #{tokenId} GROUP BY token_id) -- 3. 최종 합체 및 등락률 계산 SELECT t.token_id, t.token_name, t.ticker_symbol, p.market_price as marketPrice, p.open_price as openPrice, COALESCE(ds.daily_high, p.market_price) as highPrice, COALESCE(ds.daily_low, p.market_price) as lowPrice, COALESCE(ds.daily_vol, 0) as dailyTradeVolume, CASE WHEN p.open_price = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((p.market_price - p.open_price) / p.open_price * 100), 2) END as changeRate FROM tokens t JOIN Prices p ON t.token_id = p.token_id LEFT JOIN DailyStats ds ON t.token_id = ds.token_id WHERE t.token_id = #{tokenId}
